name: Wavelet-space Volume Rendering with Newton-Cotes Quadrature
definition: A volume rendering technique where attenuation $\alpha$ and color source $q$ are decomposed into wavelet bases (B-splines), allowing for multiresolution analysis and exact gradient computation for shading, while using Newton-Cotes quadrature for numerical integration of the rendering equation.
summary: Wavelet-space Volume Rendering with Newton-Cotes Quadrature integrates the rendering equation directly in the wavelet coefficient domain using error-bounded quadrature rules, avoiding explicit spatial reconstruction.
